name: WhatsApp Uncles | Stand-up comedy by Atul Khatri
description:
Being an uncle myself , I am surrounded by  fellow uncles on WhatsApp and on behalf of all them I apologize to you all :-) 

This is the 6th video from my "Daddy Kool" show which I took it across the world last year. More videos will be coming soon..

Now touring India with my new show. All tickets
